autoharness consumer feedback: backlogit item status state machine allows only blocked -> active; there is no blocked -> queued path, so a blocked item cannot return to the ready pool without first going active. The doctor doc contradicts the implementation. CONFIRMED 2026-07-23: (1) internal/config/defaults.go default Transitions map has blocked:{active} only (queued:{active,blocked}, active:{done,blocked,review,shipped,abandoned}, review:{done,accepted,rejected}, done:{archived}). (2) docs/cli-reference/backlogit_doctor.md long-help says: 'transition the task with backlogit move {id} --status blocked (and --status queued to resume)' -- documents a blocked->queued transition that ValidateTransition rejects. DECISION NEEDED (Stage): either add blocked->queued to the transition map (return-to-ready semantics) OR correct the doctor doc to --status active. Cross-check prior deliberation docs/decisions/2026-07-05-gate-repeated-failure-requeue-ownership-deliberation.md and any backlog-integration docs referencing the resume path.
